payload.summary: The candidate's development advantage did not survive the reported holdout. Reject this candidate, and treat the historical result as non-prospective because the holdout had prior exposure and exact Thursday feature timestamps are incomplete.
findings: Validated evidence: reported held-out log-loss edge versus Deadeye was -0.0043 with a 95% interval wholly below zero.
Descriptive only: candidate development point estimate was +0.0021, but its interval included zero.
Unknown: exact Thursday cutoff parity and fully timestamped historical features were not established.
next_hypotheses: Accumulate enough immutable Thursday-locked weeks to compare frozen candidate forecasts with Deadeye and market on identical games before drawing a prospective conclusion.
